[SWS_DM_00369] Maximum number of busy responses
⌈
If the number
of negative responses for a requested diagnostic request reaches the value defined in
the configuration parameter maxNumberOfRequestCorrectlyReceivedRespon-
sePending, the Diagnostic Server instance module shall cancel the process-
ing the active diagnostic request (according to [SWS_DM_00482]) and send a negative
response with NRC 0x10 (General reject).
⌋

[SWS_DM_00369] Maximum number of busy responses
⌈
If the num-
ber of negative responses for a requested diagnostic request reaches the value de-
fined in the configuration parameter maxNumberOfRequestCorrectlyReceive-
dResponsePending, the Diagnostic Server instance module shall cancel the
processing of the active diagnostic internal or external request processing, according to
[SWS_DM_00277], [SWS_DM_00278] and send a negative response with NRC 0x10
(generalReject).
⌋
